author: Mgcarter91

The game starts off great, but the fun is beaten down by little to no new abilities and strategies as the game progresses with very repetitive battles and slow pacing.

author: Mgcarter91

author: Mgcarter91
quote: An early contender for game of the year. The environments and exploration are great and rewarding. The combat is original and a fun game loop. This one of the few games that really gives me that feeling of pure wonder and joy like when a great game came out when I was a kid. It gives me hope for the future of gaming in days when some games are lackluster

author: Mgcarter91
quote: This game has a lot of potential and can be fun in stretches, but many of the quests are either boring or too limited in their options of completion. The realism of the game only seems to work against you. There’s also a number of crashes and bugs for a game released over a year ago

author: Mgcarter91
